@graph.headline: 7 Freshdesk Alternatives for Different Support Teams
@graph.description: Compare Freshdesk alternatives by ticketing, channels, pricing models, AI fees, team size and migration needs to find a help desk that fits your workflow.

mainEntity.name: What is the best alternative to Freshdesk?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no single best choice for every team. Zendesk is a direct broad help desk comparison, Zoho Desk suits small teams and Zoho users, Help Scout suits email-first teams, and the other options fit collaboration, messaging, ecommerce or phone-led workflows.

mainEntity.name: Does Freshdesk have a free plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Freshdesk's official help article describes a Free Program for two agent seats for six months after the trial. It applies to Freshdesk, not Freshdesk Omni, so it should not be treated as a permanent free plan.

mainEntity.name: Which option is closest to Freshdesk?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zendesk and Zoho Desk are useful first comparisons for a conventional help desk. Compare the actual channels, routing, reporting and plan limits rather than relying on a broad product label.

mainEntity.name: Which Freshdesk alternative is best for ecommerce?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gorgias is designed around ecommerce customer support and is worth evaluating for Shopify-centered workflows. Check its ticket allowance, AI outcome charges and channel add-ons against your real monthly volume.

mainEntity.name: Can Freshdesk data be migrated to another help desk?

acceptedAnswer.text: Some data can be exported, but the available format depends on the export method. Freshdesk says a filtered ticket export does not include the full conversation or archived ticket history, so review the account export guide and test a sample before switching.
